contract: Generate exact requested count into new directory; default 100
acceptance: Count of manifest entries equals count of .eml files

contract: Seed defaults to 0; derive separate per-message per-component SHA-256 namespaces
acceptance: Same canonical plan and pinned toolchain yield identical .eml bytes and manifest

contract: Versioned JSON plan with exact fixture allocations and resolved profiles
acceptance: Saving and replaying plan reproduces checksums

contract: One instance of every selected fixture before cycling sorted IDs
acceptance: Reject count below minimum; manifest summary gives exact per-fixture counts

contract: Integer weights with largest-remainder allocation and stable ID ties
acceptance: Exact count and allocations independent of iteration order

contract: Build representative multilingual coverage from the MVP across Latin scripts Japanese and Arabic RTL; expand locale breadth in subsequent releases
acceptance: Core pack includes en_GB en_US fr_FR de_DE es_ES it_IT ja_JP ar_EG; assert script encoding and text direction; later packs broaden coverage

contract: Separate versioned client profile and provider profile with compatibility registry
acceptance: Each manifest lists both IDs revisions and ordered expected headers

contract: From To Cc Reply-To Date Message-ID Subject MIME-Version plus optional trace list and threading headers
acceptance: Assert header multiplicity ordering encoding and controlled values; Bcc absent from wire by default

contract: ASCII UTF-8 LF-to-CRLF normalization and explicit transfer encoding
acceptance: Decoded body and charset match manifest

contract: HTML-only and multipart/alternative plain then HTML with escaped synthetic values
acceptance: No scripts forms remote assets tracking or active URLs

contract: PNG JPEG PDF TXT CSV with predictable names sizes media types and SHA-256
acceptance: Decoded attachment hashes match packaged assets

contract: multipart/related with HTML referencing deterministic Content-ID
acceptance: Every cid reference resolves exactly once within related subtree

contract: Support simple trees and explicit depth parameter with fixed node budget
acceptance: Manifest preorder part paths types and tree depth equal serialized tree

contract: Deterministic Message-ID In-Reply-To References and message/rfc822 attachments
acceptance: Every referenced generated ID exists and timestamps follow thread order

contract: 7bit quoted-printable base64; RFC 2047 subjects and RFC 2231 filenames
acceptance: Decoded values correct; raw encodings explicitly asserted

contract: ISO-8859-1 Windows-1252 ISO-2022-JP GB18030 where representable; UTF-8 international headers separate profile
acceptance: Reject unsupported charset/text combinations; no silent transliteration

contract: Versioned manifest.json containing raw hashes semantic expectations and structural paths
acceptance: Manifest provides positive presence and negative absence assertions without relying solely on parser output

contract: Explicit --include-stress plus stress fixture selection; deterministic bounded raw-byte mutations
acceptance: Each mutation has stable ID exact offsets expected defects and recommended parser outcome

contract: Enforce count byte node depth header and attachment caps before and during streaming writes
acceptance: Over-budget request fails before publishing destination

contract: No sending DNS network reads remote resources shell execution or real inbox samples
acceptance: Generation succeeds with network denied and assets packaged locally

contract: Export valid corpus as Maildir with exact bytes and deterministic flags
acceptance: Client can import mailbox; stress files remain separate

contract: Verify manifest hashes safe assets required headers plan coverage and normal MIME invariants
acceptance: Detect tampering; stress validation checks planned anomalies without recursive unbounded parsing

contract: Stable error codes JSON diagnostics option and exit status
acceptance: Usage/config 2; IO/validation 1; success 0

contract: List profiles fixtures locales and limits; plan without writing .eml
acceptance: JSON catalog and plan stable for same inputs
